mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article(title, content, status, channel_id, pub_date, type, image) VALUES(#{title}, #{content}, #{status}, #{channelId}, #{pubDate}, #{cover.type}, #{cover.image})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM article WHERE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY pub_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS publishedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS draftCount, COALESCE(SUM(read_count), 0) AS totalReadCount, COALESCE(SUM(comment_count), 0) AS totalCommentCount, COALESCE(SUM(like_count), 0) AS totalLikeCount FROM article ${spec}
SELECT type, image FROM article WHERE id = #{articleId}
SELECT * FROM article WHERE pub_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY pub_date DESC, id DESC
SELECT * FROM article WHERE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY pub_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 50
